about.metaDescription: Usha is the company behind Usha Platform — the platform for human expression. Get to know the vision and where we're headed.
about.title: About us
about.lead: Usha is the company behind Usha Platform — the platform for human expression.
about.p1: We believe the best moments happen when people meet for real — in movement, in play, and in creating together. Usha Platform brings creators, experiences and participants together in one place, where passion meets professionalism and every booking feels safe. All creators are BankID-verified and all payments are handled securely, so you can focus on what actually matters: the experience.
about.p2: Usha was founded by Pablo Acosta, who works at the intersection of dance, technology and community-building. The vision is simple: to build a place where creativity can thrive, talent can be seen, and people can come closer together.
about.p3: We're building step by step, with real experiences from day one. This summer we start with The Kiz Lab — open dance training every week in Stockholm. From there we grow into recurring monthly parties and, further ahead, an annual festival that brings the whole community together.
about.closing: This is just the beginning. Welcome to join us from the start.

faq.title: Questions &
faq.a1: Free during beta. On sold tickets we take a commission: 15% on the free plan, 8% on Gold and 3% on Premium. You always see your share before publishing.
faq.a2: Hosts and creators verify with BankID — it keeps everyone safe. Attendees can usually buy a ticket without verifying.
faq.a3: Ticket revenue flows via Stripe straight to your account. You can cash out fast — the first instant payout each month is free.
faq.q4: Can guests buy without an account?
faq.a4: Yes. Guests can buy a ticket with just an email and get a QR code to show at the door — no account needed.
faq.q5: Can I get help from others?
faq.a5: Yes, in two ways. Per event you invite your crew (creators, taxi dancers, volunteers, co-hosts), delegate ticket scanning and agree on fees. If you run a venue you can also build a team for the venue itself and decide what each person may do — the finances always stay with you.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: These terms of service (“Terms”) govern your use of the Usha Platform (the “Platform”) provided by Usha AB, based in Malmö, Sweden (“Usha Platform”, “we”, “us”). By creating an account or using the Platform you accept these Terms.
terms.s2Body: Usha Platform is a marketplace that connects creators, experience providers and customers. The Platform lets you publish services, book experiences and make payments. Usha Platform acts as an intermediary and is not a party to agreements between creators and customers.
terms.s3Body: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account. You are responsible for keeping your login details secure. All activity under your account is your responsibility. Usha Platform reserves the right to terminate accounts that breach these Terms.
terms.s4Body: Payments are handled through Stripe. By using the Platform you also accept Stripe’s terms of service. Usha Platform charges a commission on transactions according to the plan the creator subscribes to (Free: 15%, Gold: 8%, Premium: 3%).
terms.s5Body: Cancellations can be made by both customers and creators. Cancellation terms are set by the creator for each individual service. Usha Platform is not responsible for any disputes regarding cancellations.
terms.s6Body: All content you upload to the Platform remains your property. By publishing content on the Platform you grant Usha Platform a non-exclusive right to display and distribute the content within the scope of the service.
terms.s7Body: Usha Platform provides the Platform “as is” without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for indirect damages, lost profits or loss of data. Our total liability is limited to the amount you have paid to Usha Platform during the last 12 months.
terms.s8Body: Usha Platform reserves the right to change these Terms. Material changes are announced by email or via the Platform at least 30 days before they take effect. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated Terms.
terms.s9Body: These Terms are governed by Swedish law. Any disputes shall be resolved primarily through negotiation and secondarily by a general court, with Malmö District Court as the court of first instance.
terms.s10BodyPre: Questions about these Terms? Contact us at

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: Usha AB is the data controller for the processing of your personal data. We process your data in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Swedish law.
privacy.s2Items:
Account details: name, email address, profile picture
Payment details: handled by Stripe (we store no card details)
Booking history: dates, times, services you have booked
Communication: messages via the platform
Technical data: IP address, browser type, device information
privacy.s3Items:
Provide and improve our service
Manage bookings and payments
Send confirmations and notifications
Prevent fraud and abuse
Comply with legal obligations
privacy.s4Body: We process your data based on: performance of a contract (to deliver the service), legitimate interest (to improve the platform), consent (for marketing) and legal obligation (accounting).
privacy.s5Body: We share your data with: Stripe (payment processing), Supabase (data storage), Resend (email delivery). We never sell your personal data to third parties. Data may be shared with authorities if required by law.
privacy.s6Body: We keep your data for as long as your account is active. When you delete your account, your personal data is anonymised and hidden immediately: your profile is removed from all public areas, your login is blocked and the link to your email address and BankID is released so you can register again. Data we are legally required to keep (e.g. payment and accounting records for 7 years) is retained for the statutory period and then erased. This action cannot be undone.
privacy.s7Intro: Under the GDPR you have the right to:
privacy.s7Items:
Request access to your data
Request rectification of incorrect data
Request erasure (“the right to be forgotten”)
Restrict the processing of your data
Object to processing
Request data portability
Withdraw consent
privacy.s8Body: We take appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data, including encryption in transit and at rest, access control and regular security reviews.
privacy.s9BodyPre: For questions about how we handle your personal data, contact us at
privacy.s9BodyPost: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY).

trackDesc.C1: You invoice in your own name via Stripe. Usha only takes a commission and charges VAT only on that. The responsibility is yours.

trackDesc.C3: You're registered as a volunteer. Only expenses against receipts can be paid out – never compensation.
trackDesc.C4: The association invoices as the seller. Usha takes a commission. The responsibility is the association's.
trackDesc.V1: Venue registered as a B2B buyer. Payment via Stripe. Can be a client.
trackDesc.V2: Association/culture house (not VAT-registered). The creator sells in "someone else's name", so VAT is charged on the commission, not the whole fee.
trackDesc.V3: Public sector. B2B invoice with PO/reference. Consider procurement rules and framework agreements.

refundPolicy.heading: Refund Policy
refundPolicy.overviewBody: Usha Platform facilitates bookings between customers, creators and organizers. When you cancel a paid booking before it has been completed, you receive a full refund to the same card used for the payment.
refundPolicy.cancellationPendingBody: The customer or creator can cancel at any time. Any payment is refunded in full.
refundPolicy.cancellationConfirmedBody: The customer or creator can cancel. Any payment is refunded in full.
refundPolicy.cancellationCompletedBody1: The booking cannot be cancelled via the platform. Contact the other party directly or
refundPolicy.danceBody1: A dance package is a prepaid product with a specific number of dances that are redeemed gradually at events. Once one or more dances have been redeemed, the package is considered partially consumed. The package can only be refunded in full if
refundPolicy.danceBodyStrong: no dances have yet been redeemed
refundPolicy.danceBody2: In the case of partial consumption, contact support for assessment.
refundPolicy.b2bBody: A request without approval can be withdrawn at no cost. Once the taxi dancer has accepted the request and the organizer has paid, the standard policy above applies: a full refund upon cancellation before the event is completed.
refundPolicy.timelineBody1: Refunds are initiated immediately via Stripe when the booking is cancelled. The amount normally appears on your card within
refundPolicy.timelineBody2: depending on your bank and card issuer.
refundPolicy.disputesBody1: In the event of a disagreement between customer and creator/organizer, or if a refund has not arrived after 10 banking days, email
refundPolicy.disputesBody2: with the booking ID and a brief description. We mediate and investigate.
refundPolicy.platformFeeBody: Upon a refund, the entire amount is refunded to the customer. The commission Usha Platform charged from the creator is also returned, so no party bears the cost of a proper cancellation. Cases where fraud or abuse is suspected are investigated separately.

value.heading: Why Usha Platform for taxi dancing?
value.paidBody: The money lands in your account via Stripe Connect after every booking. Reduced commission for taxi dancers — 8% on the free tier (compared with 15% standard), 5% on Gold.
value.bankidBody: Every taxi dancer confirms identity and age with Mobile BankID. It builds trust between customer, organiser and dancer.
value.packagesBody: Sell prepaid dance packages that are redeemed gradually at events, or offer private lessons with calendar booking. Both flows are included.

how.heading: How it works
how.customersStep1: Search for a taxi dancer via the filter or the link above.
how.customersStep2: Choose a dance package (prepaid, redeemed at events) or coaching (a specific time).
how.customersStep4: Meet on the dance floor or in the studio. The dancer marks each dance as redeemed in the app.
how.organizersStep1: Send an event request from the taxi dancer's profile — date, time, venue, compensation.
how.organizersStep2: Add perks (entry, drinks, hotel) that make the offer attractive.
how.organizersStep3: The taxi dancer accepts or declines shortly.
how.organizersStep4: Pay via the platform once the request has been accepted. The money goes straight to the dancer.

positioning.heading: What taxi dancing is — and is not
positioning.body: A taxi dancer is a paid dance partner for partner dancing (bugg, foxtrot, salsa, tango, lindy hop and others) at public or private dance occasions, or an instructor giving private lessons. The service does not include sexual or intimate contact. Use beyond this breaches Usha Platform's terms of service and leads to suspension.

meta.title: Getting started with Usha Platform
meta.description: A guide for creators and venues: create an account, verify yourself, publish and get paid.

guide.title: Getting started with Usha Platform
guide.intro: This guide takes you from an empty account to your first booking. Read the parts that apply to you — creator, venue, or both.

s1.title: Create an account
s1.p1: Go to usha.se and choose Get started. You can sign up with Google, Facebook or an email address — it takes seconds.
s1.roleTitle: Pick the right role straight away
s1.roleBody: You choose a role when you sign up, and that choice drives the whole app: what you see, what you can create and how you get paid.
s1.creator: Creator — you offer services: dance, photography, music, workshops.
s1.venue: Venue — you run a place and want to fill it with events.
s1.customer: Audience — you want to book things and go to them.
s1.roleNote: If you pick the wrong one you can change it later under Subscription → Change role. But it is easier to get it right from the start, and this is the most common mistake we see.
s1.companyBody: If you sell anything you also say whether you do it as an individual or through a company. Companies verify their registration number and appear with it on the receipt. You can change this later.

s2.title: Verify yourself
s2.p1: Everyone who sells on the platform verifies their identity with Swedish Mobile BankID. It is not a formality — it is the whole reason a stranger dares to book you.
s2.p2: You will find it under Profile. It takes under a minute and only has to be done once.
s2.companyBody: Also enter your registration number under Profile and press Verify company. We check it against the EU business register and fill in the legal name automatically.

creators.title: If you are a creator
creators.profileBody: A picture, a short text about what you do, and where you are based. Your profile is what people see before they book, so a few minutes here are well spent.
creators.servicesBody: A service is something someone can book: a private lesson, a photo session, a DJ set. Set a price and a length. On the free plan you can have three.
creators.calendarBody: Mark when you are available and people can book those times directly without asking first. You can subscribe to your Usha calendar from your phone.
creators.eventsBody: Running a course or an evening? Create an event with tickets instead. Every ticket gets a QR code you scan at the door.

venues.title: If you run a venue
venues.pageBody: You get your own page where your events are gathered. Visitors can follow you and then hear when something new is coming up at your place.
venues.eventsBody: Create events, set ticket prices and sell directly. You can have several ticket types on the same evening — for example workshop, social dancing, or both.
venues.requestsBody: When someone else posts an event and names you as the venue it lands under Requests. Nothing shows on your page until you approve it. An approval covers that event — the organiser keeps their event, you get the visibility.
venues.teamBody: Under The team you invite people and decide what each of them may do: create events, see bookings, scan at the door, send messages, see statistics or manage the venue page. There are ready-made presets if you would rather not tick boxes.
venues.teamNote: The finances can never be handed out. Payouts, Stripe and company details belong to the owner account and cannot be ticked for anyone else. If someone else is to handle the finances that is a change of owner, not a permission.

money.title: The money
money.stripeBody: Go to Payouts and press Connect Stripe account. Stripe asks for your details and bank account and verifies you. That is their requirement under money-laundering rules, and the one step nobody can do for you.
money.commissionBody: We take a commission on what you sell: 15 per cent on the free plan, 8 per cent on Gold and 3 per cent on Premium. You always see your share before you publish.
money.betaNote: During the beta all plans are free.
money.payoutBody: The money goes through Stripe to your account. You can withdraw once it becomes available — card payments are not released the same second, but after Stripe settles them.

faq.title: Common questions
faq.a1: Yes, if you sell something. People who only buy a ticket do not.
faq.q2: Can guests buy without an account?
faq.a2: Yes. They give an email address and get a QR code to show at the door.
faq.q3: I picked the wrong role when signing up
faq.a3: Go to Subscription and choose Change role. The other roles plans are there — during the beta they cost nothing.
faq.q4: Can several people manage the same account?
faq.a4: Venues can build a team and hand out permissions. Creators can invite co-organisers and crew per event.
faq.q5: What if I have to cancel?
faq.a5: You can refund the tickets from the event. Attendees are told automatically.
